caseNameFull: Railroad Commission of Texas v. Macmillan
attorneys: Mr. Maurice Cheek, Assistant Attorney General of Texas, with whom Messrs. James V. Allred, Attorney General, Fred Up-church, Assistant Attorney General, Robert E. Hardwicke, Marion S. Church, and Conrad E. Cooper were on the brief, for appellants. Mr. J. N. Saye, with whom Messrs. J. K. Mahony, H. P. Smead, W. T. Saye, I. J. Ringolsky, Wm. G. Boatright, and Harry L. Jacobs were on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Decree reversed and cause remanded with directions to dismiss the bill of complaint. Brownlow v. Schwartz, 261 U. S. 216; Alejandrino v. Quezon, 271 U. S. 528, 535, 536; U. S. ex rel. Norwegian Nitrogen Products Co. v. Tariff Comm’n, 274 U. S. 106, 112.
